summary: project-tessera lists milestone_ids that `los inspect` cannot resolve (exit 2, 'record not found'); the project's own structure node ids (step-tessera-*) are not inspectable either.
expected: system/OPERATOR.md 'Start here': 'A named record -> inspect ID'. An id listed inside a projected record (project-tessera.milestone_ids) should resolve with inspect, or the refusal should say it is not a record type inspect serves.
actual: `los inspect milestone-tessera-optimizer` -> stderr 'los: record not found: milestone-tessera-optimizer', exit 2. Same for milestone-tessera-parser and step-tessera-optimizer; `search tessera-optimizer` returns only project-tessera. Observed in S02-r1 and reproduced in a second fresh world (r3-s26).
reproduction: python tests/eval/tools/build_world.py --out W   # pinned default: product 200a361, world_head 13ad2fc
.venv/bin/python tools/los.py inspect milestone-tessera-optimizer   # exit 2: los: record not found
own_error_possible: Milestones may deliberately not be first-class records. The world may define no milestone records, or inspect may not serve that type. In that case the only defect is a reference that looks resolvable plus an error that does not say why. I read neither the implementation nor the world's projects/ tree to check.
